description: This file defines the class AttendancePluginConfiguration which implements plugin configuration for the Attendance plugin in the OrangeHRM system. It registers an attendance service within the dependency injection container during initialization.

classes.name: AttendancePluginConfiguration
classes.description: Handles plugin configuration for the Attendance module, primarily registering the AttendanceService during initialization.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin configuration by registering the AttendanceService in the dependency injection container.
